subtitle: Latest news from Andersson & Hensfelt.
texpoText: Last week we had the honor of speaking a little about mommi at Techella TechXpo. Almost exactly one year ago, we, Alinia and Emelie, attended TechXpo for the very first time. The idea for mommi already existed back then, but we had not written a single line of code for the app yet. We arrived nervous and perhaps a little unsure if we would truly fit in. We left feeling motivated, inspired, and with the realization that we can do this too. We are incredibly grateful that we got the opportunity to return to the event. Techella is truly an amazing place for women in tech to support, encourage, and inspire one another. Thank you for such a wonderful event!

techellaTitle: We shared our journey at Techella!
techellaText: We had the opportunity to attend Techella and share our journey with mommi – from the initial idea to building an app that helps moms find new friends. We are so grateful for the opportunity to share our story and for all the warmth and inspiration we took away from the event!
srLinkText: Read the full feature on Sveriges Radio
srText: We recently joined P4 Sveriges Radio to talk about Mommi. Thank you for giving us the opportunity to share the message about Mommi with more mothers.
svtText: SVT recently featured mommi and the journey behind the app - so exciting! In the feature, Alinia talks about how the idea for the app came to life, how mommi works, and why safety has been such an important part to create for our mommis. She explains why we chose to only allow mothers in the app and how that connects to our vision of creating a safe and welcoming space where moms can connect, share experiences, and find community.
